contextType.description: Controls whether the workspace loads Quickview or Flowboard data.

dashboardId.description: Quickview dashboard name or Flow GUID.

displayName.description: Optional human-readable label. For Flow, this is typically the TITLE fetched from the database.

lastPromptDate.description: Date when the Flow version bump prompt was last shown, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

pendingBump.description: Version field selected for the next Flow save operation.
